questions.question: Step [14] of the close order, the root. On your answer to the root halt the three prevrun text banks are held out of data/ in the scratchpad, each read back by sha256. The halt's own bank data/b769_put_3.json and the answers pair, which the root names, were then committed as relay f6a94b0a with its step row 0407cec3. Both came after the pre-root push, so HEAD stands two commits past the remote's main 897c3749, and the root wants HEAD to be the remote's main. The one-call tool's branch route makes push-b769-preroot, push-b769-record or push-b769-closing alone, and it refused a fourth name; push-b769-preroot stands in the clone at 897c3749, merged into main and never pushed under its own name, and the other two are the branches of steps [19] and [25]. N5 names the branches deleted, the relay's three push-b768-* and the papers' two, and no other (data/b769_ferry.txt :181); a push by plain git falls outside N5's one-call tool or gated push. b765 met this halt at its root, and its author answered "Remake push-b765-preroot (Recommended)" (data/b765_events_postseal.txt :138); b765's N5 read HELD at its close. Which route moves the relay's main for the root?

options.label: Remake push-b769-preroot (Recommended)
options.description: The local push-b769-preroot, merged into main and never pushed under its own name, deleted by the one-call tool's delete route; made again at 0407cec3 by its branch route; the gated push, main read back; then the root and the close as ordered. The delete stands beyond N5's list of branches deleted, on your word, as b765's did; the branch stands again for b770's step zero to remove, and the closing message names the delete beside N5's reading.

options.label: Halt the close at the root
options.description: The root not computed; steps [14] to [25] carried to the next ruling, as b765's second option read. The relay's main stays at 897c3749 and the papers' repository's at 054e1f6e; the rows found after the lock stay in the seat's scratch source and the three held banks in the scratchpad for that ruling, and the scores wait with the close.

options.label: Another route
options.description: You name the route in your own words; the close waits at step [14] until then, nothing committed, moved or pushed.
